answer: Resist sybils with a curated identity registry. Listing requires a stake anyone can challenge; disputes go to reputation-weighted vote of listed members, and the losing stake is slashed to pay the winner. The registry becomes a tended orchard: healthy identities grow standing while fakes get pruned the moment a challenger, paid to spot them, flags them. An attacker must out-stake every watcher or keep each fake healthy under constant challenge; every dispute locks capital through its whole pulse, so farming an orchard of juniper clones means funding N simultaneous defenses with no cheap exit.
